scenes.visual: illustration of an oval airplane window seen from the passenger seat, close-up, the inner window pane has one tiny round hole near its bottom edge, bright blue sky and soft white clouds outside, window shade pulled half up, the window in the lower two-thirds of the frame
scenes.narration: Next time you fly, look at your window. See that tiny *hole* near the bottom? Why would anyone drill a hole in a plane window?
scenes.delivery: curious, a little amused, like pointing it out to the friend in the next seat

scenes.visual: illustration of a young Indian woman sitting in an airplane window seat, side view, she leans toward the oval window with raised eyebrows and a surprised, slightly worried face, simple cabin interior
scenes.narration: At *35,000* feet? Sounds like a terrible idea, right? Relax. It's there to keep you safe.
scenes.delivery: playful mock-worry on the first two lines, then calm and reassuring
scenes.headline: AT *35,000 FT*?

scenes.visual: 2D animation: a plane climbs while a dashed pocket of outside air thins out and a big counter drops from 100% to 25%
scenes.narration: Here's the thing. As the plane climbs, the air outside gets *thinner*. Up there, it's about a *quarter* of what you breathe on the ground.
scenes.delivery: explaining, leaning in, slow and amazed on 'about a quarter'
scenes.headline: AIR GETS *THIN*

scenes.visual: illustration of a calm airplane cabin interior seen down the aisle, rows of seats with relaxed passengers, a row of oval windows along the side wall
scenes.narration: But the cabin keeps its air thick, so you can breathe easy. So all that air *pushes* on the window. Hard.
scenes.delivery: building up, short and firm on 'Hard.'
scenes.headline: CABIN AIR *PUSHES*

scenes.visual: 2D animation: cross-section of the window, three panes, the middle pane's tiny hole lets cabin air into the gap so the push lands on the outer pane
scenes.narration: Your window isn't one sheet. It's *three*. The hole is in the middle one... so the whole push lands on the strong *outer* pane.
scenes.delivery: like revealing a magic trick, a pause before 'so the whole push'
scenes.headline: THREE *PANES*

scenes.visual: illustration of an airplane window from inside at sunset, warm orange sky and clouds outside, a relaxed hand resting on the armrest below the window, peaceful mood
scenes.narration: The middle pane just waits, as the *spare*, in case the outer one ever cracks. So that hole isn't a weak spot. It's the backup plan. Oh, *that's* why!
scenes.delivery: the reveal: build up slowly, then a warm, satisfied smile on the last words
scenes.headline: IT'S THE *BACKUP*

scenes.visual: 2D animation: a phone shares this video to a friend who replies
scenes.narration: Next flight, find the hole and show whoever's sitting next to you. They'll think you're a pilot.
scenes.delivery: light and friendly, grinning, like a fun tip for the next trip
scenes.headline: SHOW A *FRIEND*
